description: Compares the annual dorm cost with an apartment: monthly rent over the number of months, plus annual utilities, extra food cost, and commuting cost. Returns both annual totals, the difference, and which is cheaper. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive Dorm vs Apartment calculator.

commute_annual.description: Annual commuting cost for the apartment in USD.

food_extra_annual.description: Annual extra food cost versus the dorm meal plan in USD.

months.description: Months of rent per year; default 12.

utilities_annual.description: Annual utilities cost for the apartment in USD.

name: calculate_dorm_vs_apartment
